archive_policy: Every original campaign file, preparation bundle, freeze/draw/selection, registration, release metadata, build record/log, requirements and hosted replay/comparison is retained unchanged. Build wheels, source.zip and extracted compiler sources remain in the original GitHub artifact until its explicit expiry; they are not duplicated in Git. No raw measurement or failure is omitted.

freeze.execution: unchanged protocol: ten blocks, two warmups, three measured compilations
freeze.qualification: local event record; not an independent timestamp or attestation
